>locked at -2 by definition

Generally it is at -2, but there are also exceptions that are worth mentioning! One would be peroxides (R-O-O-H), where both oxygens are -1 and R-O-F (such as e.g. Me-O-F) where the oxygen would be at 0. 
Just wanted to add that :)
